decisions.statement: A slug joins the name of the seat to the id the subagent runs under.
A run of hyphens between the seat's name and the subagent's own id is written as one.
An agent id joins the seat's id to the id the subagent runs under.
An agent id keeps a mark a slug would collapse.
A page sits in a folder of its own.
A page's folder is named for the subagent.
A page's files sit in the page's folder.
A subagent whose page is already flat keeps that page rather than taking a second.
Where those pages sit is asked of the composing rather than written out here.
That folder is read from the checkout this code is in rather than from the root handed in.
A root handed in says only whether a page is already there at the flat path.
A seat is named here only by a page the index files as a seat of its own.
The pages under a seat are asked of the index rather than listed off a folder.
A page is under the longest seat name the index files that its slug opens with.
A seat whose name opens another seat's name is under no page of that other seat.
A seat the index files no name for is under every slug that opens with its name.
A seat named by nothing is under every slug that opens with a hyphen.
Nothing here takes a page away, writes one, or lands anything.

definition: the slug and path a subagent's page is named by, and the seat a slug is under
